kind: portable classic UNP weight lifecycle contract; not an executable or installed order

actorPreparation.when: Immediately after each owned creation, before its human baseline or any measurement; reverify after every race/model/load transition.
actorPreparation.scope: Each of the two owned actors; global engine switches are not required.
actorPreparation.onUnavailableOrIncompleteFreeze: Stop before baseline/measurement; a reference flag alone does not prove controller collision is disabled. Do not guess or repeat an uncertain mutation.

humanResources.requiredProof: Original Renewal body, hand and foot meshes must be actual process VFS winners. Record each selected original archive member and installed size/hash. Disable overriding generated CBBE/3BA/BHUNP body resources; a mod name alone is insufficient.
humanResources.triRequirement: No body TRI is expected from the original Renewal archive. Do not substitute BHUNP/UUNP or generate fake human morph keys.

sourceAdmission.weightSource: Measured actual NPC weight in 0..100, supplied to $actor.weight without replacing it by a BodySlide value.
sourceAdmission.onEqualOrUnavailableWeights: Stop as a fixture/admission limitation before claiming UNP diversification; do not invent values or silently replace an actor.
sourceAdmission.genericTraits: Capture actual available typed human head/stature values before transformation; distinguish unavailable from zero.
sourceAdmission.ordinaryMorphs: Retain the actual aggregate and contribution-key baseline if available. An empty map is valid; a failed query is unavailable, not an empty map.

requiredChecks: Both actors bind to the explicit installed UNP default, never an old saved matrix.
Compare every female target, including zero/absence, with the shared native evaluator using measured weight and available traits.
Within each captured source vector, vary only ordinary human body keys offline: the UNP outputs must remain identical.

Hold measured generic traits fixed and evaluate the two measured weights offline: at least one weight-linked body target must differ; compare the corresponding complete observed vectors without confusing head differences with weight influence.
Refresh once, save/load both distinct owned references once, resolve their fresh identities and preserve profile/output/source state.
Return both actors to their witnessed human races, preserve original weight/traits/keyed values, remove own wolf morphs, then transform again and compare.
Retain all positions/headings and actual AI/collision/locomotion hold states; finish through the game menu and verify restoration.
executionBoundary: A qualified operator must bind actual installed payloads, process VFS, dependencies, exact source/profile, adapter and exclusive installation/game ownership. This source file grants no launch or readiness.
